findings.title: Committed generated artifacts drift without a gate
evidence: .gitignore:59-63 — licenses.json, sbom.cdx.json and sbom.spdx.json are listed as generated artifacts that must stay untracked
.github/actions/dependency-audit/action.yml:30-41 — 'Ensure generated license/SBOM artifacts stay untracked' fails CI when git ls-files finds any of the three
git ls-files -- licenses.json sbom.cdx.json sbom.spdx.json → empty at 8d299b8d (re-verified)
Fix commit 3e7a39bb 'fix(supply-chain): untrack generated license aggregate and gate artifact drift' is an ancestor of HEAD
Residual: apps/web/public/version.json:1-6 — committed generated file still says "sha": "unknown" and "date": "2026-08-05T00:46:23.829Z"; no CI check references version.json

Residual: docs/openapi.yaml:1-4 — auto-generated snapshot; CI only validates buildSpec() and route coverage (.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:27,33); no step regenerates and diffs the committed YAML

Residual: docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c/findings.json — 'generated' bumped to 2026-10-11T03:36:51Z and two statuses flipped open→verified-fixed in 7a8eb1ce while its audit_manifest.json still binds commit 9c0b88c
findings.impact: Generated aggregates can silently drift from their sources. The fix only covers the license/SBOM artifacts; version.json is demonstrably stale and openapi.yaml has no sync gate, so the original class of problem persists for the remaining committed generated files.
findings.recommendation: Extend the artifact-drift gate: add a CI step that runs `pnpm --filter=api generate:openapi` plus `git diff --exit-code docs/openapi.yaml`, and either untrack apps/web/public/version.json (generate it in predev/prebuild) or add a check that it was regenerated. Keep the existing untracked gate for licenses.json/sbom*.json.
findings.note: Re-verified at 8d299b8d: the license/SBOM untracked gate and .gitignore entries are present and effective (3e7a39bb). Residual documented: version.json is stale and unguarded, docs/openapi.yaml has no regenerate-and-diff gate, and the committed previous-run audit artifacts were amended in place. Previous run had this as verified-fixed via the a97425d ledger; status downgraded to partially-fixed on fresh evidence.

findings.title: Duplicate schema bootstrap SQL can be mistaken for the source of truth
evidence: docs/portal_platform_formal_handoff_bundle/supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.sql:16-21 — 'HISTORICAL / GENERATED COPY - DO NOT EDIT (INV-P2-002)' names supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql as the live source of truth
supabase/migrations/5302026_supabase_consolidated_fresh_bootstrap_20260529.corrected.v3.sql exists (69 KB) as the live chain entry
Fix commit 0a2e5331 'chore: close P2 batch (hygiene/inventory/ci/test/obs) [PATCH-013]' is an ancestor of HEAD
findings.impact: Without the header a reader could edit the hand-off snapshot instead of the migration chain and silently diverge from the deployed schema. The header closes that path.
findings.recommendation: Keep the header; optionally move the file under a docs/archive/ path in a future docs restructure.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: the do-not-edit/historical header (lines 16-21) is present and names the migration chain as authoritative; fix commit 0a2e5331 is an ancestor of HEAD.

findings.title: Large committed prompt/audit corpus inflates the application repository
evidence: Fix commit fd27150f removed 157 prior-run report files (prompts/ 787→630) and regenerated prompts/manifest.json; prompts/PROVENANCE.md documents the pin and the 'not instructions' posture
git ls-files prompts → 632 files = 630 pinned + manifest.json + PROVENANCE.md; re-implementing verify-prompts.js hashing (UTF-8 + CRLF→LF) in Python gives 0 missing, 0 added, 0 hash mismatches
.github/workflows/validate.yml:94-107 — prompt-provenance job runs `node scripts/verify-prompts.js verify` as a deploy gate
Residual note: prompts/ is still ~12 MB on disk; validate.yml:105 comment still says '787 files'
findings.impact: The corpus still inflates the repo (12 MB, 632 files), but it is now pinned, documented and gated, so silent tampering is blocked and the prior finding's remediation (removal of run snapshots + pinning) is effective.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add a size/file-count budget for prompts/ and refresh the stale '787 files' comment in validate.yml; otherwise no action.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: manifest verifies against the working tree with the same normalization the script uses (0 mismatches), the validate workflow runs it as a deploy gate, and PROVENANCE.md records the pin. Residual size noted.

findings.title: Stale, machine-specific repo path in the agent reference
evidence: AGENTS.md:3 — 'Repo: github.com/MaineCyberTech/mainecybertech' (canonical slug)
Fix commit 2d4e6788 'docs: fix stale repo path and a11y gate counts; guard a11y counts (AI-P1-002)' is an ancestor of HEAD
review.md body (after the generated banner) is byte-identical to AGENTS.md; .github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:63 and validate.yml:110 run `node scripts/sync-review-md.mjs --check`
Remaining C:\temp\... mentions (e.g. AGENTS.md:975) are historical narrative text, not repo-path references
findings.impact: Agents no longer read a machine-specific path as the repository location; the generated mirror cannot drift because CI checks it.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: AGENTS.md carries the canonical slug and review.md is in sync (verified by comparing bodies) with a CI --check guard.

findings.title: Committed build artifact apps/web/public/version.json is stale and unguarded
evidence: apps/web/public/version.json:1-6 — committed build metadata still says branch 'unknown', run '0', sha 'unknown', date '2026-08-05T00:46:23.829Z'
apps/web/scripts/generate-version.js:9-23 — writes public/version.json from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION/GIT_SHA/BUILD_TIME at build time
apps/web/package.json:8 — build runs `pnpm generate:version && next build`; apps/web/lib/version.ts:4,10 falls back to the committed versionData when env vars are absent (dev / badge)
No CI guard: grep for 'version.json' in .github and scripts finds no check; the dependency-audit untracked gate only covers licenses.json/sbom*.json
findings.impact: Local/dev builds and any build path that skips generate:version surface stale 'unknown' build metadata (the VersionBadge in the UI), and the file contradicts the repo's own 'generated artifacts stay untracked' policy.
findings.recommendation: Either untrack apps/web/public/version.json (add a predev/prebuild generation step and keep it out of git), or add a CI check that regenerates it and fails on drift.
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; specific instance of the residual in 'Committed generated artifacts drift without a gate'.

findings.title: Vestigial Vercel deploy configs remain after the DigitalOcean migration
evidence: vercel.json — root Vercel config {"framework": "nextjs"}; apps/web/vercel.json — {"installCommand": "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"}
git log for both files → last touched 2b3f02de on 2026-06-09, before the DigitalOcean migration
README.md:73,110-121,293 document DigitalOcean droplet + Caddy + GHCR images as the deploy path; no workflow or app code references Vercel (grep over .github/apps/scripts)
docs/DEPLOYMENT_OPTIONS_COMPARISON.md:3-5 marks the Vercel option as historical
findings.impact: Two deploy configs for a platform that the docs and CI no longer use create ambiguity about the supported deploy path and can trigger an unintended Vercel auto-deploy if a project is still linked.
findings.recommendation: Delete both vercel.json files, or add a header note if Vercel previews are still intentionally supported; confirm no Vercel project auto-deploys from this repository.
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; the Vercel dashboard/project link state cannot be inspected from the repository, so 'unused' is inferred from docs/CI/config age.

findings.title: Previous-run audit artifacts are amended in place without rebinding to the commit they now reflect
evidence: docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c/findings.json — 'generated' changed 2026-10-10T05:58:32Z → 2026-10-11T03:36:51Z in 7a8eb1ce (merged to main by 8d299b8d); DR-P2-001 and INFRA-P2-006 flipped open→verified-fixed
docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c/audit_manifest.json still records scope.commit 9c0b88c and scaffolded_at 2026-10-05
findings.json rows carry "note": "" so the reconciliation evidence (dates/PRs) lives only in follow_up_register.md, not the machine-readable artifact
docs/audits/README.md layout contract states 'Never overwrite a previous run'
findings.impact: The committed record of the 9c0b88c run no longer binds to 9c0b88c; a machine consumer of findings.json can read statuses with no provenance, and the run manifest contradicts the artifact set it ships with.
findings.recommendation: Either freeze run outputs and publish reconciliations as a new run directory, or add a per-finding verified_at_commit/reconciled_at field and update audit_manifest.json when a run is amended; also carry the reconciliation note into findings.json.
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; reproduced from the committed diff e4db0a0c..8d299b8d and the manifest/findings.json mismatch.

findings.title: Committed Supabase Studio scratch snippet duplicates a dev seed
evidence: supabase/snippets/Untitled query 314.sql — 109-line Studio snippet, byte-identical to supabase/seeds/00_local_auth_users.corrected.v2.sql (diff reports no differences)
Added in the initial commit 4a87279f; contains local test-user bcrypt hashes (values redacted; header says LOCAL / DEV ONLY)
supabase/config.toml:5-15 seeds only seeds/00..08, so the snippet is not part of the reset flow and will never be executed
findings.impact: Two copies of the same dev seed can drift; a Studio-generated scratch filename in the repo invites accidental edits and makes the seed inventory ambiguous.
findings.recommendation: Delete supabase/snippets/Untitled query 314.sql (seeds/ is the source of truth) or, if it must be kept, rename it under seeds/ with an explicit purpose.
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; duplicate verified by diff and by config.toml seed list.

findings.title: Service worker asset apps/web/public/sw.js is not registered anywhere
evidence: apps/web/public/sw.js:1-12 — service worker with CACHE_NAME 'mct-cache-v1' and a hardcoded STATIC_ASSETS list (/, /login, /store, ...)
grep for 'serviceWorker|sw.js' over apps/web (excluding node_modules) → no registration call; apps/web/app/layout.tsx:26 references only /manifest.webmanifest
File tracked since f02ec685 ('audit remediation: complete P0/P1/P2/P3 fixes')
findings.impact: The asset is dead today, but if it is registered later its hardcoded cache list and version will serve stale pages; it also makes PWA coverage look more complete than it is.
findings.recommendation: Either register it deliberately (versioned cache, update/activation flow, network-first for HTML) or delete it. MOB-P3-001 covers the related duplicate PWA manifest sources.
findings.note: New finding at 8d299b8d; absence of registration verified by grep across the web app.

report:
# Comprehensive Repository Inventory

## Audit Metadata

- Audit name: repo-deep-dive
- Run: `mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8`
- Repository: `https://github.com/MaineCyberTech/mainecybertech`
- Branch: `main` (worktree at `/tmp/opencode/mct-audit-target`, detached HEAD, clean)
- Commit SHA: `8d299b8dc271c410b9ae2ceeda3d2c6c997af8fd` (`8d299b8d`)
- Generated at: 2026-10-11 (read-only pass)
- Auditor: domain subagent (area `INV`)
- Area code: INV
- Output path: `docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8/01_repository_inventory.md`
- Scope limitations: no `node`/`pnpm` runtime available on the audit host, so no generator or test suite could be executed; all verification is static (git, grep, file hashing, JSON parsing). No network/GitHub API access, so live branch-protection/environment state is not re-verified. The target worktree is read-only; nothing was modified.

## Scope

Reviewed at `8d299b8d` (repo state: `git status --porcelain` → 0 files, branch `main` via worktree of `/root/mainecybertech`): root configs; pnpm/turbo workspace files; the three applications (`apps/api`, `apps/web`, `apps/worker`); shared packages (`packages/config`, `packages/sdk`, `packages/ui`); database artifacts (`supabase/migrations`, `seeds`, `policies`, `functions`, `snippets`, `config.toml*`); GitHub metadata (`.github/workflows`, actions, CODEOWNERS, branch-protection JSON, dependabot, templates); tests (jest/playwright); docs (`docs/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `review.md`, `README*.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`); assets (`apps/web/public`); generated artifacts (committed and untracked); Docker/deploy/infra (`docker-compose.yml`, `infra/**`); environment examples. Not reviewed in depth: application business logic, RLS policy content, CI workflow internals, Terraform resource details — those belong to other domains; this report only inventories them.

## Evidence Reviewed

| Evidence | Type | Why relevant | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `turbo.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` (493 KB) | root/workspace | Monorepo shape and task graph | 3 apps + 3 packages; `apps/*`, `packages/*` |
| `apps/api` (327 files), `apps/web` (1012), `apps/worker` (53) | applications | Runtime surface | Dockerfiles + `.env.example` per app |
| `packages/config` (5), `packages/sdk` (69), `packages/ui` (30) | shared packages | Reuse boundary | SDK holds generated `database.types.ts` |
| `supabase/migrations` (134 `.sql`), `supabase/seeds` (9), `config.toml` | database | Schema/seed chain | latest `5302436_restore_platform_admin_rls_gates.sql` |
| `.github/**` (34 files, 20 workflows) | GitHub metadata | CI/CD + governance | composite actions, branch-protection JSON, CODEOWNERS |
| `apps/web/e2e` (90 specs), jest configs, coverage thresholds | tests | Release confidence | counts guarded in docs |
| `docs/**` (364 files), `AGENTS.md` (1003 lines), `review.md` (generated mirror) | docs | Operator/agent readiness | docs counts + links guards |
| `apps/web/public` (6 files) | assets | PWA surface | `sw.js`, two manifests, `version.json` |
| `prompts/**` (632 files, 12 MB) + `prompts/manifest.json` | generated corpus | Supply-chain pinning | verified clean |
| `docs/audits/**` (75 files, 2.9 MB) | generated outputs | Audit ledger | previous run dir amended in place |
| `docker-compose.yml`, `infra/**` (25 files) | deploy/infra | Local + prod runtime | DO compose + Terraform + Caddy |
| `*.env.example` (4 files), `.gitleaks.toml`, `security/*.json` | env/security | Sensitive inventory | placeholders only |

## Verification Performed

Exact commands run (read-only) and observed results at `8d299b8d`:

| Command | Observed result |
|---|---|
| `git log --oneline -1`, `git status --porcelain` | `8d299b8d …`, 0 dirty files; worktree clean |
| `git ls-files \| wc -l` | 2823 tracked files; top dirs: apps 1392, prompts 632, docs 364, supabase 152 |
| `git ls-files -- licenses.json sbom.cdx.json sbom.spdx.json` | empty → untracked gate would pass |
| `git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard` | empty → no tracked-but-ignored files |
| `git ls-files -s \| awk '$1=="100644" && $4~/\.sh$/'` | empty → validate.yml exec-bit gate would pass |

| `git log --format=… -1 -- docs/openapi.yaml` and `-- apps/api/src/openapi/spec.ts` | both last changed in `1c1bd4ad` (2026-10-04) → aligned, but no CI sync gate exists |
| `git diff e4db0a0c 8d299b8d -- docs/audits/…/findings.json` | `generated` 2026-10-10→2026-10-11; DR-P2-001/INFRA-P2-006 `open`→`verified-fixed` |

| `python3` link check for `docs/INDEX.md` (164 links), `README.md` (12 links) | 0 missing targets (matches intent of `check-docs-links.mjs`) |
| Counts vs `AGENTS.md` rows (migrations 134, workflows 20, scripts 81, prompts 632, components 102, e2e specs 90, seeds 9, worker tasks 12, sdk modules 60) | all match → docs-counts guard would pass |
| `git merge-base --is-ancestor` for fix commits `3e7a39bb`, `0a2e5331`, `2d4e6788`, `fd27150f` | all ancestors of HEAD |
| `du -sh` per dir | apps 18M, prompts 12M, docs 8.1M, supabase 1.9M; 4 tracked files > 1 MB (2× products.json app copies, 2× prompts-pack copies) |

Not reproducible on this host (recorded as Unknown, not as pass): `pnpm test` / coverage totals (no node runtime); `generate-db-types.js --check`; `openapi-audit.js`; `check-docs-counts.mjs` / `check-docs-links.mjs` / `verify-rls.mjs` execution; `pnpm build`; anything requiring GitHub or the droplet.

## Executive Summary

The repository is a well-organized Turborepo monorepo (3 apps, 3 packages, 134 migrations, 632-file pinned prompt corpus, 20 workflows, 364 docs) with an unusually strong set of self-checking guards for a project of this size: prompt provenance pinning, docs count/link checks, DB-type freshness, RLS predicate linting, branch-protection parity, untracked-generated-artifact checks, and coverage thresholds. Repo state at audit time is clean (`main 8d299b8d`, no dirty files).

The previous INV findings all hold up: the bootstrap-SQL header, the prompt-corpus pinning, and the canonical repo slug are present and effective at this commit. However, the original "generated artifacts drift without a gate" finding is only partially closed — the gate covers `licenses.json`/`sbom*.json`, while `apps/web/public/version.json` is demonstrably stale and unguarded and `docs/openapi.yaml` has no regenerate-and-diff check. Two additional inventory-level issues surfaced this pass: the committed previous-run audit artifacts (`docs/audits/…/9c0b88c/`) are amended in place (statuses flipped, `generated` timestamp moved to 2026-10-11) while the run manifest still binds commit `9c0b88c`, and a handful of questionable committed artifacts remain (a Studio scratch snippet duplicating a dev seed, an unregistered service worker, vestigial Vercel configs).

Recommended next actions, in order: (1) extend the artifact-drift gate to `version.json` and `openapi.yaml`; (2) decide the audit-ledger policy (freeze runs vs. per-finding `verified_at_commit`); (3) delete or re-home the scratch snippet and the unregistered service worker. None of these are release-blocking.

## Findings

### Finding ID: INV–P2-001 - Committed generated artifacts drift without a gate

- Severity: P2
- Confidence: High
- Area: INV
- Evidence:
  - `.gitignore:59-63` — `licenses.json`, `sbom.cdx.json`, `sbom.spdx.json` untracked
  - `.github/actions/dependency-audit/action.yml:30-41` — untracked gate (fix `3e7a39bb`)
  - `apps/web/public/version.json:1-6` — stale committed build artifact
  - `docs/openapi.yaml:1-4` + `.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:27,33` — no sync gate
  - `docs/audits/…/9c0b88c/findings.json` — regenerated 2026-10-11 while manifest binds `9c0b88c`
- What is happening: The original fix untracked and gated the license/SBOM aggregates, but other committed generated artifacts remain ungated and one is demonstrably stale.
- Why it matters: Generated files can silently diverge from their sources; consumers then trust stale output.
- User / business impact: Low direct; medium for tooling/consumers of the OpenAPI snapshot and build badge.
- Security / privacy / reliability impact: Low; mostly provenance.
- Recommended fix: Add `generate:openapi` + `git diff --exit-code` and a version.json check to CI; keep the untracked gate.
- Suggested validation: Introduce a deliberate drift and confirm CI fails; revert.
- Owner suggestion: repo maintainer / platform CI owner
- Effort estimate: S
- Dependencies: none
- Status: partially-fixed
- Endpoint / data path: n/a
- Attack path: none identified
